summary.oneLiner: Aastha Spintex Limited is a Gujarat-based B2B manufacturer of carded, combed and compact combed 100% cotton yarns and cotton bales, operating an integrated spinning-and-ginning facility at Halvad, Morbi.
summary.business: Manufactures and trades carded, combed and compact combed cotton yarns (counts Ne 26 to Ne 40) and cotton bales at a semi-automated integrated spinning-and-ginning facility in Halvad, Morbi, Gujarat. Cotton bales are used both for captive yarn production and for sale to other spinning units; yarns serve knitting/weaving end-uses (denim, terry towels, shirting, sheeting, sweaters, socks, home and industrial textiles). Operates exclusively B2B, selling directly within Gujarat and, for out-of-state/export markets, through a reseller arrangement with 7 Seas Impex.

currentContext.business: Manufactures and trades carded, combed and compact combed cotton yarns (counts Ne 26 to Ne 40) and cotton bales at a semi-automated integrated spinning-and-ginning facility in Halvad, Morbi, Gujarat. Cotton bales are used both for captive yarn production and for sale to other spinning units; yarns serve knitting/weaving end-uses (denim, terry towels, shirting, sheeting, sweaters, socks, home and industrial textiles). Operates exclusively B2B, selling directly within Gujarat and, for out-of-state/export markets, through a reseller arrangement with 7 Seas Impex.

By-products: cotton waste (comber, licker-in, hard waste from spinning)

currentContext.expansion: The principal growth step is the acquisition of Falcon Yarns Private Limited (a spinning company) funded from the Issue proceeds (Rs 11,151 lakhs part payment plus Rs 1,000 lakhs inter-corporate deposit for Falcon's working capital), which adds spinning capacity and scale to the existing 25,920-spindle / 7,700 MT yarn and 12,000 MT cotton-bale integrated facility at Halvad. The company has also built captive renewable power (solar + wind) to reduce operating costs.
